rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Dodon loves Parvi, mo. Parvi alone
won't get mad and call Dodon useless
when Dodon messes up, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Dodon isn't very capable, mo. More
often than not, I just hold my
companions back, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Some days I get so down I think I'd
be better off all alone, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0005
rows.name:
But Parvi said Dodon was her partner,
mo. She believed in Dodon, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0006
rows.name:
So Dodon will live up to that trust,
mo! Together, we'll find some amazing
treasure, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000058_03_msg0007
rows.name:
I don't really need to live it up, mo.
Dodon just wants to stay beside Parvi
and do what makes her happy, mo.
